scenicChapters.title: Izu Skyline and Jogasaki Coast fuel gate → Tokyo / Kanto rides return
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 74 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

tokyo-kanto-rides-izu-skyline-and-jogasa.story: 337 km one way from Yashio - plan on about 6 h 56 of riding. It goes by way of Kumagaya, near Itsukaichi and Kawasaki. The climbs: near Fujisawa and near Kisarazu. Much of it runs through woodland.
